plansPage.title: Choose Your Modules
plansPage.subtitle: The core is free. Pay only for the modules you need.
plansPage.noPlans: No modules available for purchase right now.
plansPage.redirectToPayment: You'll be redirected to payment after confirming
plansPage.toChangePlan: To add or remove modules, visit the subscription management page
plansPage.faqChangePlansAnswer: Yes, you can add modules at any time from the subscription management page. Anything added mid-year is priced pro rata to the days left until your renewal anniversary.
plansPage.faqPaymentMethods: What payment methods do you accept?
plansPage.faqPaymentMethodsAnswer: We accept all major credit and debit cards through PayTR, our secure Turkish payment provider.
plansPage.faqCancelAnytimeAnswer: Yes. Renewal is manual: if you don't pay, only the paid modules lose access at the end of the period. The free core keeps running and no data is deleted.
plansPage.faqFreeTrialAnswer: There is no trial period — the core is free forever. POS, kitchen display, menu, tables, QR menu and basic reports need no credit card and no licence.
